query: SELECT j.library_id AS "library_id: Uuid", COALESCE(l.name, 'Sans bibliothèque') AS "library_name!: String", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "succeeded_count!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "failed_count!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND j.output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN j.source_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "source_bytes!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND j.output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN j.output_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "output_bytes!: i64" FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN libraries l ON l.id = j.library_id GROUP BY j.library_id, COALESCE(l.name, 'Sans bibliothèque') ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND j.output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN j.source_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN j.status = 'succeeded' AND j.source_bytes IS NOT NULL AND j.output_bytes IS NOT NULL THEN j.output_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0)) DESC, 2 ASC
